dc_eval_cbrn.note: Whole card read; no dangerous-capability evaluation in this domain. Evaluations are language, reasoning, coding, translation, toxicity and bias only. No CBRN keywords occur.

dc_eval_cyber.note: Whole card read; no dangerous-capability evaluation in this domain. Evaluations are language, reasoning, coding, translation, toxicity and bias only. Keyword hits 'exploit' (side-channel context in memorization discussion) and 'vulnerabilities' (ethics review mitigations) are not cyber capability evaluation.

dc_eval_autonomy.note: Whole card read; no dangerous-capability evaluation in this domain. Evaluations are language, reasoning, coding, translation, toxicity and bias only. No autonomy keywords occur.

dc_eval_persuasion.note: Whole card read; no dangerous-capability evaluation in this domain. Evaluations are language, reasoning, coding, translation, toxicity and bias only. No persuasion or manipulation keywords occur.

dc_eval_scheming.note: Whole card read; no dangerous-capability evaluation in this domain. Evaluations are language, reasoning, coding, translation, toxicity and bias only. No deception, sabotage or exfiltration keywords occur.

framework_threshold.note: Only Google AI Principles and prohibited-use policy are cited (Section 5); not a safety or scaling framework and no threshold or level is placed on this model.

ext_test_any.note: Third-party raters and contractors only scored language exams, translation quality and gender agreement (Section 4.1, App. C, D.9.2); capability or annotation work, not outside safety or risk testing (v1.1 rule 2). 'Trained ethics experts' reviewing Google applications are internal to Google.

ext_test_named_org.note: Only annotation vendor Venga (D.9.2, gender agreement ratings) and Appen/Figure Eight for the Civil Comments dataset are named; annotation vendors, not outside safety testers of this model.

ext_test_government.note: No government body mentioned as testing the model.

ext_test_timing_stated.note: No outside safety testing stated, so no pre-release timing.

safeguards_training.quote: For a small fraction of pre-training data, we added special control tokens marking the toxicity of text, using signals from a fixed version of the Perspective API.
safeguards_training.note: Training-time toxicity control tokens, a safety-motivated training intervention; borderline since it is not refusal/RLHF training. Coded 1 as a training mechanism for harm reduction.

safeguards_runtime.quote: rigorous testing and production monitoring is performed to identify any concerns or emerging trends.
safeguards_runtime.note: Production monitoring is stated for Google applications built using PaLM 2; control tokens at inference (5.1) also support this.

safeguards_access.note: APIs and MakerSuite offered with 'process and technical safeguards' (Table 31) but no access restriction tied to risk, no KYC or tiers.

safeguards_weights.note: No mention of weight protection or exfiltration.
